name: Ai ROBOTICS INC.
summary: Ai Robotics Inc. is a Japanese company mainly in advertising. Its core product, SELL, is an AI system that automates advertising tasks such as brand analysis and product development, running marketing, handling customer support and managing supply chain, inventory and customer relationships. Formerly HowTwo! Inc., it took its present name in 2020 and has its head office in Minato, Japan.
